description: Stable identifier for the test or applicant profile
Primary income/employment segment used to select segment-specific rules
Completed age on the evaluation date
Regular net monthly income used for public affordability checks
Total current EMI obligations before the proposed loan
Optional credit bureau score; when absent a published CIBIL rule is marked untestable rather than failed
Total salaried work experience across employers
Continuous tenure with the current employer
Continuous operating history of the present business or profession
Lender IDs where the applicant already has the account relationship required by the captured product
Whether the applicant is an Indian resident where the product requires it
Loan amount requested by the applicant
Requested repayment period used for maturity-age and affordability calculations
